title: Travis Hunter feels lighter on his feet after putting on 10 pounds

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Travis Hunter feels lighter on his feet after putting on 10 pounds
sources.description: Travis Hunter's mixture of size and speed made him a two-way player at Colorado and it led the Jaguars to trade up to take him with the second overall pick of the 2025 draft, but that didn't stop him from changing his body ahead of his second NFL season.
